Name: Magical Crops
Author: shekurika
Description:
The wizard has encountered many strange things during his travels.
Recently he found some strange seeds and needs your help to grow them...


This mods 7 magical crops,  8 quests and 4 events that form a little story. You get the seeds for the new crop by mail, event or quest. After you have gotten the seeds for the first time, you can buy more in the wizards Tower at the seed chest. Some crops do [i]strange [/i]things during their growth.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

Available in [b]English,[/b] [b]Turkish[/b], [b]Portuguese[/b] and [b]Chinese


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2126765]Fate0of0man[/url] made a support patch for Better Artisan Goods Icons [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10930]here[/url][/b]

[b]
I strongly suggest to not open the spoilers below as they contain, well, spoilers. [/b]Only read them when you are stuck/have a problem.

[b]Crops:[/b]

[spoiler]
[b]King Parsnip[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7fegCLK.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in spring
- obtainable after 17 spring Y1
[/spoiler]

[b]Lucky Roll[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kV1m5wT.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in summer
- obtainable summer Y1
- grows randomly 1-6 stages if watered
- has small chance to yield 100 fruits
[/spoiler]

[b]Slime Plant[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/L0vbPaz.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in fall
- obtainable after 4 fall Y1
- attracts slime (50% to attract slimes, 2 if close to water, 5% chance to spawn 10 instead)
[/spoiler]
[b]Sunset Drops[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B1iZiYC.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in fall
- obtainable after 10 fall Y1
- moves to the closest empty tile to the left over night, can jump up to 10 tiles far.
[/spoiler]

[b]Balanced Plant[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/udbMZqb.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in winter
- obtainable after 6 winter Y1
- only water when black
[/spoiler]

[b]Cake Plant[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1pLT3hm.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in fall
- obtainable after 10 spring Y2
- needs cake in a 3x3 area around it to grow. (Place down decorative cake, you should have 2 crafting recipes)
[/spoiler]

[b]Invisible Plant[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NBujt9k.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows in Summer
- obtainable after 2 Summer Y2
- is invisible
[/spoiler]

[b]Inexistent Plant[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5SO5lQe.png[/img]
[spoiler]
- grows all year round and regrows
- obtainable after getting Ancient Seeds recipe and finishing quest
- picks a random place in a 7x7 field and picks a random growth stage
[/spoiler]

[/spoiler]
